title: Zura Spa Organogram
summary: Roles, reporting lines, and responsibilities across the Zura Spa team.

sections.title: 1. Zura Group / Founder
paragraphs: Role: Owner and overall business vision holder.
list: Provides overall direction for Zura Spa.
Approves major business decisions.
Guides brand growth, structure, and long-term planning.
Ensures the spa aligns with the broader Zura Group vision.

sections.title: 2. Executive Director
paragraphs: Role: Overall head of Zura Spa operations, standards, and service direction.
list: Oversees the full operation of Zura Spa.
Sets service standards and brand expectations.
Supervises leadership, staff conduct, and performance.
Approves policies, processes, training, and improvements.
Ensures client satisfaction and business growth.

sections.title: 3. Spa Manager / Operations Manager
paragraphs: Reports to: Executive Director
list: Manages daily spa operations.
Ensures staff follow routines, processes, and standards.
Handles staff attendance, discipline, and work coordination.
Monitors client experience and service delivery.
Ensures rooms, tools, and facilities are ready for operation.
Escalates major issues to the Executive Director.

sections.title: 4. Supervisor / Team Lead
paragraphs: Reports to: Spa Manager / Operations Manager

sections.title: 4a. Staff Manager
paragraphs: Reports to: Spa Manager / Operations Manager
list: Oversees staff coordination, attendance, and daily work assignments.
Manages staff discipline, conduct, and performance monitoring.
Ensures all team members follow Zura Spa standards and routines.
Reports staff-related concerns and escalates issues to the Spa Manager.
Supports staff welfare, scheduling, and team communication.

sections.title: 4b. Lead Therapist
paragraphs: Reports to: Spa Manager / Staff Manager
list: Leads the therapy team in delivering professional Zura Massage services.
Ensures sessions are properly assigned, managed, and executed to standard.
Monitors therapist performance and service quality during operations.
Reports client concerns, session issues, and therapist conduct to the Spa Manager.
Drives continuous improvement in service delivery and client satisfaction.
Oversees therapist training, correction, and professional development.
Reviews and confirms morning shift handover reports from all therapists.
Oversees daily assessments and routine/procedure practice sessions.
Reviews and evaluates session reports submitted by therapists.
Submits weekly performance reports on therapists' execution and delivery of massage sessions.

sections.title: 4c. Supervisor
paragraphs: Reports to: Spa Manager / Staff Manager
list: Supervises therapists and support staff during daily operations.
Checks room readiness, tools, and staff appearance before sessions begin.
Ensures daily checklists and work packs are completed accurately.
Reports operational issues and coordinates real-time floor management.
Supports training, correction, and overall staff improvement.
Conducts regular stock counts of all spa equipment and supplies.
Maintains accurate records of equipment inventory and condition.
Ensures routine maintenance is carried out and supervises all repairs and fixes.
Monitors stock levels and ensures timely restocking of supplies.
Submits a daily report covering staff conduct, work climate, client count, repairs completed, stock used, stock remaining, and any concerns related to conduct, inventory, or compliance.

sections.title: 4d. Hygiene Manager
paragraphs: Reports to: Spa Manager / Supervisor
list: Maintains and enforces hygiene standards across all spa areas.
Inspects rooms, tools, linens, and shared spaces for cleanliness and readiness.
Coordinates with housekeeping staff and available staff/therapists to ensure consistent hygiene compliance.
Reports hygiene concerns, damaged items, or sanitation risks promptly.
Ensures all hygiene protocols align with Zura Spa standards.

sections.title: 4e. Therapist Guide
paragraphs: Reports to: Lead Therapist / Staff Manager
list: Onboards and guides newly hired therapists and support staff during their first month.
Introduces new staff to Zura Spa service standards, routines, and expectations.
Provides hands-on support, correction, and mentorship throughout the onboarding period.
Monitors new staff progress and reports readiness to the Lead Therapist or Staff Manager.
Ensures new team members are fully integrated and confident before independent operation and handing over to Lead therapist.

sections.title: 5. Receptionist / Client Manager
paragraphs: Reports to: Spa Manager / Supervisor
list: Welcomes clients and manages client communication.
Handles bookings, calls, chats, and appointment confirmation.
Coordinates client arrival and session flow.
Communicates client preferences to therapists.
Supports payment confirmation and client follow-up.
Maintains a warm and professional front-desk experience.
Submit accurate session logs at the end of each shift daily.

sections.title: 6. Zura Wellness Experts / Massage Therapists
paragraphs: Reports to: Supervisor / Spa Manager
list: Provide professional Zura Massage services to clients.
Prepare and clean massage rooms before and after sessions.
Maintain hygiene, appearance, and professional conduct.
Follow Zura Spa service standards and instructions.
Attend trainings, assessments, and performance reviews.
Report client concerns, room issues, and tool conditions.
Support client satisfaction and brand reputation.

sections.title: 7. Social Media Manager / Content Lead
paragraphs: Reports to: Executive Director / Spa Manager
list: Manages Zura Spa social media content and online presence.
Coordinates staff content creation.
Promotes services, offers, client education, and brand visibility.
Works with staff to capture professional content.
Ensures online communication reflects the Zura Spa brand.

sections.title: 8. Cleaner / Housekeeping Staff
paragraphs: Reports to: Supervisor / Spa Manager
list: Cleans the kitchen, reception, waiting area, rooms, lounge, veranda, and other assigned areas.
Ensures floors, surfaces, waste bins, and shared spaces are clean.
Supports room reset and general cleanliness.
Reports cleaning issues or damaged items.
Maintains hygiene standards across the spa.

sections.title: 9. Security Officer
paragraphs: Reports to: Spa Manager / Supervisor
list: Opens and closes the gate.
Controls entry and exit.
Confirms with management before allowing visitors in.
Observes the environment within and around the premises.
Arranges cars and maintains order in the car park.
Cleans the security room, staircase, car park, and flower beds.
Ensures staff do not leave with uniforms.
Reports suspicious activity or security concerns.

sections.title: Simple Reporting Structure
paragraphs: Zura Group / Founder
↓ Executive Director
↓ Spa Manager / Operations Manager
↓ Staff Manager / Team Lead / Client Manager / Lead Therapist
↓ Receptionist / Client Service Officer | Zura Wellness Experts | Cleaner / Housekeeping | Security Officer
Social Media Manager / Content Lead may report directly to the Executive Director or work with the Spa Manager, depending on the task.
